runes.name: Power
runes.about: The word of force.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit.
runes.behind: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life.

runes.name: Poison
runes.about: The word of venom. A slow death.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons. Poison stacks.
runes.behind: Leaves a cloud of poison.
runes.monster: Poisons you.

runes.name: Frost
runes.about: The word of cold.
runes.front: Frost damage. Chills, then freezes.
runes.behind: Passes through, hits softer, leaves ice that slows.
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you.

runes.name: Flame
runes.about: The word of fire.
runes.front: Fire damage. Explodes and sets enemies burning.
runes.behind: Passes through, hits softer, leaves burning ground.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning.

runes.name: Lightning
runes.about: The word of storms.
runes.front: Lightning damage. Arcs to nearby enemies.
runes.behind: Passes through, hits softer, leaves a storm that strikes.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you.

runes.name: Swift
runes.about: The word of speed.
runes.front: Faster to use again.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster.

runes.name: Heavy
runes.about: The word of weight. Slow, and crushing.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground that staggers enemies.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back.

runes.name: Twin
runes.about: The word of doubling. Two of a thing, each the weaker for it.
runes.front: Strikes, fires or bursts twice, each time weaker.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, weaker.
runes.monster: Attacks twice.

runes.name: Leech
runes.about: The word of hunger. It takes life from what it touches.
runes.front: Heals you for every enemy hit.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you.

runes.name: Volatile
runes.about: The word of ruin. Things burst.
runes.front: Enemies it kills explode.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune that detonates a moment later.
runes.monster: Explodes when it dies.

runes.name: Precise
runes.about: The word of the exact. Narrow, and deadly.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour.

runes.name: Frenzied
runes.about: The word of rage. Faster, and faster.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt.

runes.name: Guarding
runes.about: The word of the shield. It keeps you.
runes.front: Each use gives you a brief shield.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle: you take less damage inside it.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage.

runes.name: Lasting
runes.about: The word of the long hour. What it makes, stays.
runes.front: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
runes.behind: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
runes.monster: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you.

runes.name: Fleeting
runes.about: The word of the moment. All of it, sooner.
runes.front: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
runes.behind: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
runes.monster: Its poison and burning hurt you faster.

runes.name: Vast
runes.about: The word of the wide. Broad, and lighter.
runes.front: A much bigger area, a little less damage.
runes.behind: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach wider.

runes.name: Pulling
runes.about: The word of the drawing in. Everything comes to it.
runes.front: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex that keeps drawing enemies in.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it.

runes.name: Splitting
runes.about: The word of the breaking apart. One becomes many.
runes.front: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction.
runes.monster: Splits in two when it dies.

runes.name: Hexing
runes.about: The word of the curse. What it marks is undone.
runes.front: Curses what it hits: it takes more damage from everything.
runes.behind: Leaves a hex circle: enemies inside deal less damage.
runes.monster: Its blows curse you: you take more damage.

runes.name: Stilling
runes.about: The word of the held breath. Time slows for it.
runes.front: What it hits is slowed in time.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble where enemies and their shots crawl.
runes.monster: Its blows slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Binding
runes.about: The word of the knot. What it holds stays held.
runes.front: Holds the enemies it hits in place.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare for the next enemy to cross.
runes.monster: Its blows root you to the spot.

runes.name: Piercing
runes.about: The word of the point. Nothing stands in its way.
runes.front: Goes through everything in its path.
runes.behind: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later.
runes.monster: Its shots fly through walls to reach you.

runes.name: Bleeding
runes.about: The word of the open wound. It does not close.
runes.front: Makes enemies bleed, worse while they move.
runes.behind: Leaves thorns that cut whatever walks through.
runes.monster: Its blows make you bleed.

runes.name: Reaping
runes.about: The word of the harvest. What falls is gathered in.
runes.front: Kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns.
runes.behind: Kills raise a spirit that fights for you for a while.
runes.monster: Rises once after it dies.

runes.name: Culling
runes.about: The word of the end. The weak are taken.
runes.front: Enemies left nearly dead by its hit die outright.
runes.behind: Leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it.
runes.monster: Hits much harder when you are low.

runes.name: Surging
runes.about: The word of the swell. It gathers, then breaks.
runes.front: Every third use releases a shockwave round you.
runes.behind: Your dodge releases a surge.
runes.monster: Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

runes.name: Plundering
runes.about: The word of the taking. What is theirs is yours.
runes.front: Kills drop more gold, and sometimes an extra item.
runes.behind: Gold bursts from kills and flies to you.
runes.monster: Each blow steals some of your gold, dropped when it dies.

runes.name: Mirroring
runes.about: The word of the reflection. Two of you, where there was one.
runes.front: A reflection of you makes the same attack beside you, weaker.
runes.behind: Leaves a mirror that repeats your next attack from where you stood.
runes.monster: Sends part of the harm you do it back at you.

runes.name: Eruption
runes.about: Power and Flame, melded.
runes.front: A heavy fire hit. The blast leaves a pool of molten ground.
runes.behind: Hits build heat. At full heat the next hit erupts.

runes.name: Avalanche
runes.about: Power and Frost, melded.
runes.front: A heavy cold hit that shoves enemies back and freezes the ones it stops.
runes.behind: Every hit on a chilled enemy hits harder.

runes.name: Thunder
runes.about: Power and Lightning, melded.
runes.front: One big bolt instead of arcs. It stuns.
runes.behind: Every few hits, a thunderclap bursts around you.

runes.name: Blight
runes.about: Power and Poison, melded.
runes.front: The hit is not weakened, and poison bites harder the lower the enemy's life.
runes.behind: Poisoned enemies take more damage from everything.

runes.name: Scald
runes.about: Flame and Frost, melded.
runes.front: A burning enemy that gets chilled, or a chilled one set burning, cracks for a burst of damage.
runes.behind: Fire meeting ice on the ground bursts into steam that hurts and hides.

runes.name: Wildfire
runes.about: Flame and Lightning, melded.
runes.front: Burning jumps to nearby enemies the way lightning arcs.
runes.behind: The burning ground throws sparks at enemies near it.

runes.name: Fumes
runes.about: Flame and Poison, melded.
runes.front: Burning poisoned enemies give off a toxic cloud.
runes.behind: The poison cloud explodes when anything burning enters it.

runes.name: Hailstorm
runes.about: Frost and Lightning, melded.
runes.front: Arcs chill everything they touch. Frozen enemies pass arcs on further.
runes.behind: A storm of ice that slows and strikes.

runes.name: Frostbite
runes.about: Frost and Poison, melded.
runes.front: Chilled enemies lose life over time, and frozen ones twice as fast.
runes.behind: The ice on the ground poisons what crosses it.

runes.name: Contagion
runes.about: Lightning and Poison, melded.
runes.front: Every enemy an arc touches is poisoned.
runes.behind: The poison cloud shocks whatever stands in it.

runes.name: Demolition
runes.about: Power and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: Bigger explosions. Elites and bosses also explode once, at half life.
runes.behind: One huge rune, slow to go off.

runes.name: Powderkeg
runes.about: Flame and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: Burning enemies explode when killed, and the blast sets others burning.
runes.behind: The rune leaves burning ground when it goes off.

runes.name: Shatter
runes.about: Frost and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: Frozen enemies burst into shards that hit those around them.
runes.behind: The rune freezes what is near, then bursts.

runes.name: Chain Reaction
runes.about: Lightning and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: An exploding enemy sends arcs to the nearest enemies. Those it kills explode too.
runes.behind: Runes are linked. One going off sets off the rest.

runes.name: Rupture
runes.about: Poison and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: Poisoned enemies burst when killed, splashing their poison on those around.
runes.behind: The rune bursts into a poison cloud.

runes.name: Siphon
runes.about: Leech and Poison, melded.
runes.front: Your poison heals you while it eats them.
runes.behind: Your poison heals you a little.

runes.name: Cauterize
runes.about: Leech and Flame, melded.
runes.front: Killing a burning enemy heals you a chunk.
runes.behind: Killing a burning enemy heals you a little.

runes.name: Forking
runes.about: Twin and Lightning, melded.
runes.front: Every hit arcs to a second enemy nearby.
runes.behind: Every hit arcs to a second enemy nearby, weaker.

runes.name: Shiver
runes.about: Precise and Frost, melded.
runes.front: Critical hits freeze the target for a moment.
runes.behind: Critical hits freeze the target for an instant.

runes.name: Sunder
runes.about: Heavy and Power, melded.
runes.front: Stunned enemies take extra damage.
runes.behind: Stunned enemies take a little extra damage.

runes.name: Fervor
runes.about: Frenzied and Flame, melded.
runes.front: Each kill makes you attack faster and burn hotter for a few seconds.
runes.behind: Each kill quickens you and your fire a little.

runes.name: Rime Ward
runes.about: Guarding and Frost, melded.
runes.front: Blocking a hit chills the attacker.
runes.behind: Blocking a hit chills the attacker a little.

runes.name: Implode
runes.about: Pulling and Volatile, melded.
runes.front: Drags enemies together, then the spot bursts.
runes.behind: Drags enemies together a little, then a small burst.

runes.name: Power II
runes.about: Two Power, melded: Power at rank II.
runes.front: As Power, half as strong again.
runes.behind: As of Power, half as strong again.

runes.name: Flame II
runes.about: Two Flame, melded: Flame at rank II.
runes.front: As Flame, half as strong again.
runes.behind: As of Flame, half as strong again.

runes.name: Frost II
runes.about: Two Frost, melded: Frost at rank II.
runes.front: As Frost, half as strong again.
runes.behind: As of Frost, half as strong again.

runes.name: Lightning II
runes.about: Two Lightning, melded: Lightning at rank II.
runes.front: As Lightning, half as strong again.
runes.behind: As of Lightning, half as strong again.

runes.name: Poison II
runes.about: Two Poison, melded: Poison at rank II.
runes.front: As Poison, half as strong again.
runes.behind: As of Venom, half as strong again.

runes.name: Onslaught
runes.about: Twin and Power, melded. Twin's second blow, made heavy.
runes.front: Strikes twice, and the second blow lands at full strength instead of weaker, shoving what it hits a step back.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, at full strength.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; hits harder and has more life. Its second blow lands as hard as the first and knocks you back.

runes.name: Viper
runes.about: Twin and Poison, melded. Two fangs.
runes.front: A weaker hit that bites twice: two doses of poison at once, and its poison eats twice as fast (the same poison in half the time).
runes.behind: Leaves two poison clouds; the second creeps toward the nearest enemy.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; poisons you. Each blow leaves two doses of poison on you.

runes.name: Flash Freeze
runes.about: Twin and Frost, melded. The first blow chills, the second freezes, all at once.
runes.front: Frost damage, striking twice: the first blow chills, the second freezes it on the spot (never a boss). A frozen enemy can't be flash-frozen again for a few seconds.
runes.behind: Passes through and leaves ice twice: a second patch forms a moment after the first and freezes whatever stands in it.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; deals frost damage and slows you. If you are already chilled, its second blow freezes you for a moment.

runes.name: Rekindle
runes.about: Twin and Flame, melded. A fire that comes back.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; each burn lights again once when it goes out, as hot as before.
runes.behind: Passes through and leaves burning ground that flares up once more after it dies down.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its burn on you lights again once after it goes out.

runes.name: Flurry
runes.about: Twin and Swift, melded. Speed that turns into extra blows.
runes.front: Faster to use again, and each use within a second of the last adds one more blow to it, up to four blows, each a little weaker.
runes.behind: Repeats itself sooner, and each repeat that lands gives you a burst of speed.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; moves and attacks faster, and faster still while its blows keep landing on you.

runes.name: Aftershock
runes.about: Twin and Heavy, melded. The blow lands, then the ground answers.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a moment later an aftershock bursts round where it hit, hurting and staggering everything near.
runes.behind: Its cracked ground quakes twice, as it forms and again a second later, staggering whatever is on it both times.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; its blows knock you back. A moment after each blow, an aftershock bursts where you stood: step out of its ring.

runes.name: Bloodlust
runes.about: Leech and Power, melded. Healing you can't use becomes force.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit that heals you for every enemy it hits; while you are at full life, the healing becomes extra damage instead.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives Power's damage bonus.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; hits harder and has more life. At full life, its blows hit harder instead of healing it.

runes.name: Coldblood
runes.about: Leech and Frost, melded. Drinking the warmth out of what it freezes.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; it heals you twice as much from chilled or frozen enemies.
runes.behind: Leaves ice that slows; enemies that die on the ice drop life orbs more often.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; deals frost damage and slows you. It heals twice as much while you are chilled.

runes.name: Conduit
runes.about: Leech and Lightning, melded. Life carried back along the bolt.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes heals you too.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm; each enemy its bolts strike heals you a little.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Its arcs heal the monsters they pass through.

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.about: Leech and Swift, melded. Each heal hurries you on.
runes.front: Faster to use again, and each time it heals you, its cooldown shortens a little more.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives you a burst of speed.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; moves and attacks faster. Each time it heals, it speeds up for a moment.

runes.name: Marrow
runes.about: Leech and Heavy, melded. Crush it, then drink.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; hitting a stunned enemy heals you three times as much.
runes.behind: Its cracked ground drains a little life from whatever it staggers, for you.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; its blows knock you back. Knocking you back heals it a chunk.

runes.name: Quickfuse
runes.about: Volatile and Swift, melded. No wait between the kill and the blast.
runes.front: Faster to use again; enemies it kills explode at once, and each explosion that kills shortens its cooldown a little.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune that goes off almost at once.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast goes off at once, with no time to step away.

runes.name: Concussion
runes.about: Volatile and Heavy, melded. A blast that knocks the sense out of what it hits.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; enemies it kills explode, and the blast stuns everything it catches.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune whose blast cracks the ground, staggering whatever walks over it after.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast knocks you back and stuns you for a moment.

runes.name: Duelist
runes.about: Precise and Power, melded. Deadly one on one.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; an enemy with no other enemy near it always takes a critical hit.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy; the marked one takes more damage from everything until the mark is spent.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you are alone, every hit from it is critical.

runes.name: Needle
runes.about: Precise and Poison, melded. The venom goes in exactly where it hurts.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; a critical hit puts three doses on at once.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical and doubles the poison already on it.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; poisons you. Its critical hits poison you three times over.

runes.name: Brand
runes.about: Precise and Flame, melded. A mark burned in.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes and burns; a critical hit brands the enemy, and a branded enemy burns twice as hot.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy with a burning brand: it burns until the mark is spent, and your next hit on it is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its critical hits brand you: your burn runs twice as hot.

runes.name: Seeker
runes.about: Precise and Lightning, melded. Lightning that picks its target.
runes.front: Lightning damage whose arcs jump to the enemies with the least life, and arcs can be critical hits too.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy; lightning from any of your moves arcs to the marked one first.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, its hits are critical.

runes.name: Quickdraw
runes.about: Precise and Swift, melded. The first shot is the one that counts.
runes.front: Faster to use again; the first use after two seconds without using it is a certain critical.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy; landing the marked critical gives you a burst of speed and shortens its cooldown.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow after a pause is critical.

runes.name: Pressure Point
runes.about: Precise and Heavy, melded. Strike the stunned where it's weakest.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; every hit on a stunned enemy is a certain critical.
runes.behind: Its cracked ground marks whatever it staggers: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its next blow after knocking you back is critical.

runes.name: Berserk
runes.about: Frenzied and Power, melded. The faster you go, the harder you hit.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit; each use makes the next faster and harder, up to five times.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill adds to Power's damage bonus.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; hits harder and has more life. It hits harder too as it is hurt.

runes.name: Fever
runes.about: Frenzied and Poison, melded. The poison quickens with your pulse.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; each use while frenzied adds one more dose, up to five.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a poisoned enemy dying holds it twice as long.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; poisons you. Its poison works faster the more hurt it is.

runes.name: Whiteout
runes.about: Frenzied and Frost, melded. A storm of blows that buries them in cold.
runes.front: Frost damage; each use makes the next faster, and the faster you are, the harder it slows.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going and freeze the enemies near the one that died for a moment.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals frost damage and slows you. The more hurt it is, the more it slows you.

runes.name: Overcharge
runes.about: Frenzied and Lightning, melded. The current builds with every swing.
runes.front: Lightning damage; each use makes the next faster and adds one more arc, up to five.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill throws a bolt at the nearest enemy.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals lightning damage and shocks you. As it is hurt, its lightning arcs farther.

runes.name: Blur
runes.about: Frenzied and Swift, melded. Too fast to see.
runes.front: Faster to use again; at a full frenzy of five you also move faster and dodge more.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going and give you a burst of speed.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; moves and attacks faster. Badly hurt, it becomes a blur for a few seconds, very fast.

runes.name: Juggernaut
runes.about: Frenzied and Heavy, melded. Slow to start, impossible to stop.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use makes the next faster, and at a full frenzy it is no slower at all.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going; at a full frenzy its cracked ground spreads twice as wide.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows knock you back. The more hurt it is, the farther it knocks you.

runes.name: Bulwark
runes.about: Guarding and Power, melded. Strong behind a strong shield.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds your hits land harder.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; inside it Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; hits harder and has more life. While its shield holds, it hits harder.

runes.name: Hemlock
runes.about: Guarding and Poison, melded. A shield that bites back.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is poisoned.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle that poisons enemies standing in it.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; poisons you. Hitting its shield poisons you.

runes.name: Cinderward
runes.about: Guarding and Flame, melded. When the shield breaks, it burns.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes and burns; each use gives you a brief shield that bursts in flame round you when it breaks or fades.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle ringed in fire: enemies crossing its edge are set burning.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its shield breaks, it bursts in flame.

runes.name: Static
runes.about: Guarding and Lightning, melded. Touch the shield and get shocked.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is struck by an arc.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle whose edge throws arcs at enemies inside it.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Hitting its shield shocks you.

runes.name: Windward
runes.about: Guarding and Swift, melded. Sheltered and quick.
runes.front: Faster to use again; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds you move faster.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you move faster and take less damage.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; moves and attacks faster. While its shield holds, it is faster still.

runes.name: Fortress
runes.about: Guarding and Heavy, melded. Nothing moves you.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use gives you a shield, and while it holds nothing knocks you back or stuns you.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; enemies stepping into it are staggered.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows knock you back. While its shield holds, nothing staggers or stops it.

runes.name: Momentum
runes.about: Lasting and Power, melded. Force that keeps building while you keep hitting.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit; each hit that lands makes the next a little harder, and the build-up holds until you go three seconds without landing one.
runes.behind: Power's damage bonus lasts half again as long and builds two steps higher.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; each blow it lands makes its next harder, until it stops landing them.

runes.name: Canker
runes.about: Lasting and Poison, melded. A poison that won't wear off.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison lasts twice as long and doesn't wear off while you keep hitting.
runes.behind: Leaves a poison cloud that lasts twice as long.
runes.monster: Its poison lasts longer on you; poisons you. Its poison doesn't wear off while it keeps hitting you.

runes.name: Permafrost
runes.about: Lasting and Frost, melded. Cold that never lets go.
runes.front: Frost damage; its chill lasts twice as long, and what it freezes stays frozen half again as long.
runes.behind: Leaves ice that slows and lasts until the fight is over.
runes.monster: Its chill lasts longer on you; deals frost damage and slows you. Its slow keeps deepening while you stay within its reach.

runes.name: Smoulder
runes.about: Lasting and Flame, melded. The fire outlives its fuel.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes; burns last twice as long, and an enemy that dies burning leaves smouldering ground where it fell.
runes.behind: Leaves burning ground that lasts much longer.
runes.monster: Its burning lasts longer on you; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Where it dies, the ground smoulders.

runes.name: Tempest
runes.about: Lasting and Lightning, melded. The storm stays.
runes.front: Lightning damage; enemies it shocks stay shocked longer, and for three seconds arcs keep leaping between them.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm that lasts twice as long.
runes.monster: Its shock lasts longer on you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, small arcs keep striking you.

runes.name: Tailwind
runes.about: Lasting and Swift, melded. Speed that stays with you.
runes.front: Faster to use again; each use also gives a burst of speed that lasts while you keep using it.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed that lasts half again as long.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; stays fast long after each blow.

runes.name: Bedrock
runes.about: Lasting and Heavy, melded. The ground stays broken.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun lasts half again as long.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground that lasts until the fight is over.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; you stay staggered longer after each.

runes.name: Haymaker
runes.about: Fleeting and Power, melded. A hard blow with no warning.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit, and it lands sooner: less wind-up before the blow.
runes.behind: Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast and fades in half the time.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its blows come with less warning.

runes.name: Bloat
runes.about: Fleeting and Poison, melded. The poison works fast, then bursts out.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison works in a third less time, and when it runs out the enemy bursts in a small cloud of it.
runes.behind: Leaves a poison cloud that fades fast and bursts on whatever is inside as it goes.
runes.monster: Its poison hurts you faster; poisons you. When its poison on you runs out, it bursts round you.

runes.name: Cold Snap
runes.about: Fleeting and Frost, melded. A sudden, biting cold.
runes.front: Frost damage; its chill is shorter but deeper, and hitting a chilled enemy snaps the chill off for extra damage.
runes.behind: Leaves ice that melts fast, freezing what stands on it as it goes.
runes.monster: Its chill on you is short but deep; deals frost damage and slows you.

runes.name: Flashfire
runes.about: Fleeting and Flame, melded. Burns that go up all at once.
runes.front: Fire damage; its burns do all their harm in half the time, and a burn ending sends up a flare that hits those near.
runes.behind: Leaves burning ground that burns hotter and dies faster.
runes.monster: Its burning hurts you faster; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its burn on you ends, it flares.

runes.name: Jolt
runes.about: Fleeting and Lightning, melded. All the shock in one instant.
runes.front: Lightning damage; a shocked enemy takes all of the shock's harm in a single jolt the next time you hit it.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm that lets loose all its bolts in one moment.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its shock hits you all at once.

runes.name: Blink
runes.about: Fleeting and Swift, melded. Gone before they see you move.
runes.front: Faster to use again, and for a moment after each use you move very fast.
runes.behind: Each use gives a burst of speed a third as long and much faster.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; darts at you in short, very fast bursts.

runes.name: Daze
runes.about: Fleeting and Heavy, melded. A short stun that leaves them wide open.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder; its stun is shorter, but every hit on a stunned enemy lands harder.
runes.behind: Its cracked ground staggers in quick, short jolts, more often.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; while you are staggered, it hits you harder.

runes.name: Cataclysm
runes.about: Vast and Power, melded. The bigger the crowd, the bigger the blow.
runes.front: A much bigger area; the hit lands harder for every enemy it catches.
runes.behind: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its attacks reach much wider.

runes.name: Miasma
runes.about: Vast and Poison, melded. A haze that thickens as it spreads.
runes.front: A weaker hit over a much bigger area that poisons everything it touches; the more enemies it poisons at once, the stronger each dose.
runes.behind: Leaves a poison cloud that slowly grows.
runes.monster: Poisons you; its attacks reach wider and leave a haze of poison where they land.

runes.name: Glacier
runes.about: Vast and Frost, melded. The cold spreads from one to the next.
runes.front: Frost damage over a much bigger area; when it freezes an enemy, the ice spreads to those touching it and chills them.
runes.behind: Leaves a wide field of ice that slowly creeps outward.
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; its attacks reach wider and frost the ground where they land.

runes.name: Inferno
runes.about: Vast and Flame, melded. Fire that runs across the floor.
runes.front: Fire damage over a much bigger area; burning enemies set the ground alight where they walk.
runes.behind: Leaves burning ground that spreads outward for a few seconds.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its attacks reach wider and set the ground alight.

runes.name: Stormfront
runes.about: Vast and Lightning, melded. One hit links the whole crowd.
runes.front: Lightning damage over a much bigger area; every enemy it hits is linked, and lightning flicks between linked enemies for a few seconds.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm that drifts wide, striking anything in a much bigger area.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its attacks and its lightning reach wider.

runes.name: Gale
runes.about: Vast and Swift, melded. A sweep that clears the room.
runes.front: Faster to use again, a much bigger area, and it blows the enemies it hits back to its edge.
runes.behind: Each use gives a burst of speed to you and every ally near you.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its attacks reach wider and push you away.

runes.name: Earthquake
runes.about: Vast and Heavy, melded. The stun rolls out like a wave.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun rolls out in a wide wave from where it lands, reaching the far side a moment late.
runes.behind: Leaves a wide field of cracked ground.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back from much farther away.

runes.name: Onrush
runes.about: Swift and Power, melded. Speed turned into force.
runes.front: Faster to use again; more damage and a bigger hit, and half again as hard while a burst of speed is on you.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, Power's damage bonus doesn't fade.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; hits harder and has more life. Its first blow after running at you hits half again as hard.

runes.name: Hornet
runes.about: Swift and Poison, melded. Quick stings that pile the venom on.
runes.front: Faster to use again; a weaker hit that poisons, and each use within a second of the last puts one more dose on, up to three.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, every hit you land poisons too.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; poisons you. Each blow within a second of its last leaves an extra dose.

runes.name: Glide
runes.about: Swift and Frost, melded. The ice carries you.
runes.front: Faster to use again; frost damage that chills, and each chilled enemy it hits gives you a little speed.
runes.behind: Leaves ice that slows enemies but speeds you up while you stand on it.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; deals frost damage and slows you. On ice it is faster still.

runes.name: Firewalk
runes.about: Swift and Flame, melded. Fire at your heels.
runes.front: Faster to use again; fire damage that explodes and burns, and its explosions are bigger while a burst of speed is on you.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, you leave burning footprints.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; deals fire damage and sets you burning. It leaves burning footprints where it runs.

runes.name: Quicksilver
runes.about: Swift and Lightning, melded. Lightning that carries you with it.
runes.front: Faster to use again; lightning damage that arcs, and every arc that strikes gives you a little speed.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies you run past are struck by an arc.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, it is faster still.

runes.name: Charge
runes.about: Swift and Heavy, melded. The weight of a blow without the wait.
runes.front: Hits much harder and stuns, but is no slower to use; every enemy it stuns makes it a little faster to use again.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, running into enemies staggers them.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its blows knock you back. It charges in, and its first blow knocks you back twice as far.

runes.name: Mire
runes.about: Heavy and Poison, melded. The broken ground turns to poison mud.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, and poisons; poison on a stunned enemy eats twice as fast.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground that staggers, and whatever it staggers is poisoned too.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back and poison you. While you are staggered, its poison eats faster.

runes.name: Icebreaker
runes.about: Heavy and Frost, melded. Freeze it, then break it.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with frost damage that chills; a blow on a frozen enemy breaks the ice for heavy extra damage, and the shards stagger everything around it.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground glazed with ice: whatever it staggers is chilled too.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; deals frost damage and slows you. Knocked back while chilled, you freeze for a moment.

runes.name: Anvil
runes.about: Heavy and Flame, melded. Every blow throws sparks.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with fire damage that explodes; a stunned enemy burns twice as hot.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground glowing like a forge: whatever walks over it is set burning.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Where it knocks you, the ground is left burning.

runes.name: Fulgurite
runes.about: Heavy and Lightning, melded. Lightning driven into the ground.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with lightning that arcs; its arcs stun too, for a moment.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground that carries lightning: bolts run along the cracks to whatever stands on them.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Where its blows land, the ground crackles for a few seconds.

runes.name: Lamprey
runes.about: Twin and Leech, melded. The second bite drinks deeper.
runes.front: Strikes twice; both blows heal you, and the second heals twice as much as the first.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, and the repeat heals you for every enemy it hits.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; heals when it hits you. Its second blow heals it twice as much.

runes.name: Cluster
runes.about: Twin and Volatile, melded. One blast scatters into more.
runes.front: Strikes twice; enemies it kills explode, and each explosion throws out two small bomblets that burst where they land.
runes.behind: Leaves two runes; the second goes off a moment after the first.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; explodes when it dies, scattering bomblets around it.

runes.name: Doubletap
runes.about: Twin and Precise, melded. If the first one lands true, so does the second.
runes.front: Strikes twice, a smaller area; when the first blow is a critical hit, the second is a certain critical too.
runes.behind: Marks two enemies at once: your next hit on each is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When its first blow is critical, so is its second.

runes.name: Tempo
runes.about: Twin and Frenzied, melded. Every beat counts double.
runes.front: Strikes twice, and both blows add to the frenzy, so it builds twice as fast.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, and the repeat's kills keep the frenzy going too.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; speeds up as it is hurt. Every blow it lands speeds it up a little more.

runes.name: Redoubt
runes.about: Twin and Guarding, melded. Behind the wall, another wall.
runes.front: Strikes twice; each use gives you a brief shield, and when it breaks a second, smaller one forms.
runes.behind: Leaves two ward circles, one inside the other; deep inside you take even less damage.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; carries a shield that soaks damage. When its shield breaks, a smaller one forms.

runes.name: Reverb
runes.about: Twin and Lasting, melded. Each blow rings on.
runes.front: Strikes twice, and every poison, burn, chill or shock it leaves lasts half again as long for each blow that lands.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, and what the repeat leaves lasts twice as long.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; its poison, burning and chill last longer on you with every blow that lands.

runes.name: Staccato
runes.about: Twin and Fleeting, melded. Two blows in the time of one.
runes.front: Strikes twice with no pause between, and what it leaves works in a third less time.
runes.behind: Repeats itself almost at once instead of a moment later.
runes.monster: Attacks twice, the second blow coming with no warning.

runes.name: Ripple
runes.about: Twin and Vast, melded. The second blow spreads out from the first.
runes.front: Strikes twice; the second blow lands as a wider ring around the first, catching what the first missed.
runes.behind: Repeats itself a moment later, over a much bigger area.
runes.monster: Attacks twice; its second attack reaches much wider.

runes.name: Bloodbloom
runes.about: Leech and Volatile, melded. Every blast feeds you.
runes.front: Enemies it kills explode, and each blast heals you for every enemy it catches.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune; enemies its blast kills drop life orbs.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; explodes when it dies, and its blast heals the monsters near it.

runes.name: Lancet
runes.about: Leech and Precise, melded. A surgeon's cut that feeds you.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; heals you for every enemy hit, and a critical hit heals three times as much.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy: your certain critical on it also heals you for a share of the hit.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its critical hits heal it three times as much.

runes.name: Feeding Frenzy
runes.about: Leech and Frenzied, melded. The faster you go, the more you drink.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the higher the frenzy, the more each hit heals you.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and at a full frenzy enemies it kills drop life orbs.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; heals when it hits you, more the faster it goes.

runes.name: Carapace
runes.about: Leech and Guarding, melded. Healing you can't use hardens into a shell.
runes.front: Heals you for every enemy hit; healing beyond full life becomes a shield.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you slowly heal.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; carries a shield that soaks damage, and its healing tops the shield up.

runes.name: Transfusion
runes.about: Leech and Lasting, melded. The life keeps flowing.
runes.front: Heals you for every enemy hit, and the healing keeps coming in over the next few seconds, half again as much in all.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs that last much longer and heal over a few seconds.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you, and keeps healing for a few seconds after.

runes.name: Lifeline
runes.about: Leech and Fleeting, melded. The heal comes fastest when you need it most.
runes.front: Heals you for every enemy hit; below half life, it heals twice as much.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs that fly straight to you.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; below half life, it heals twice as much.

runes.name: Bloodtide
runes.about: Leech and Vast, melded. The healing washes over everyone.
runes.front: A much bigger area, a little less damage; heals you for every enemy hit, and allies near you are healed too.
runes.behind: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits, and the splash heals you as well.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you; its attacks reach wider, and its healing reaches the monsters near it.

runes.name: Detonator
runes.about: Volatile and Precise, melded. A charge set exactly where it hurts.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit plants a charge that bursts a moment later, hurting everything near.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy; when the marked one dies, it explodes twice as big.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; explodes when it dies. Its critical hits plant a charge on you that bursts a moment later.

runes.name: Mayhem
runes.about: Volatile and Frenzied, melded. Every blast winds you up.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster; enemies it kills explode, and each explosion adds to the frenzy.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and at a full frenzy enemies it kills explode.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; explodes when it dies, and the faster it was going, the bigger the blast.

runes.name: Minefield
runes.about: Volatile and Guarding, melded. Holding ground that bites back.
runes.front: Each use gives you a brief shield; enemies it kills while your shield holds explode.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; enemies that die inside it explode.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; explodes when it dies, twice as big if its shield was still up.

runes.name: Timebomb
runes.about: Volatile and Lasting, melded. The longer the wait, the bigger the bang.
runes.front: Enemies it kills explode a second later, twice as big.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune that waits twice as long before it goes off, and goes off twice as big.
runes.monster: Explodes when it dies, a second later and twice as hard: get clear.

runes.name: Hair Trigger
runes.about: Volatile and Fleeting, melded. The slightest touch sets it off.
runes.front: An enemy brought below a tenth of its life explodes at once (never a boss).
runes.behind: Leaves a rune that goes off the instant an enemy touches it.
runes.monster: Explodes when it dies; brought very low, it bursts at once.

runes.name: Blastwave
runes.about: Volatile and Vast, melded. Blasts that clear the room.
runes.front: A much bigger area; enemies it kills explode, and each blast throws the enemies it doesn't kill out to its edge.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune whose blast covers a much bigger area.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach wider; explodes when it dies, and the blast throws you back.

runes.name: Rapier
runes.about: Precise and Frenzied, melded. Quicker, and quicker to find the gap.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; each use makes the next faster, and the higher the frenzy, the more often it lands a critical hit.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a critical kill adds two steps to it.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; its hits find the gaps in your armour, and the more hurt it is, the more often it lands critical hits.

runes.name: Riposte
runes.about: Precise and Guarding, melded. Block, then strike back true.
runes.front: Each use gives you a brief shield; whatever strikes the shield, your next hit on it is a certain critical.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; your hits on enemies inside it are critical more often.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you strike its shield, its next blow on you is critical.

runes.name: Vendetta
runes.about: Precise and Lasting, melded. It won't forget who it marked.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit marks the enemy, and every hit on it after is more likely to be critical until it dies.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy until it dies: every third hit on it is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Once it lands a critical hit on you, more of its hits are critical for a while.

runes.name: Ambush
runes.about: Precise and Fleeting, melded. The first strike is the deadly one.
runes.front: More damage, a smaller area; the first hit on an enemy that hasn't been hurt yet is a certain critical.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy for only a moment; hit it in time and the certain critical does double damage.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow on you is always critical.

runes.name: Bullseye
runes.about: Precise and Vast, melded. A wide blow with a deadly heart.
runes.front: A much bigger area, a little less damage; the enemy nearest its middle takes a certain critical.
runes.behind: Marks every enemy near what it hits, not just one: your next hit on each is a certain critical.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach wider. If you stand at the heart of its attack, its hit is critical.

runes.name: Shieldwall
runes.about: Frenzied and Guarding, melded. The harder you fight, the thicker the wall.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster and gives you a brief shield that grows with the frenzy, up to twice as big at five.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; kills inside it keep the frenzy going twice as long.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; carries a shield that soaks damage, and its shield grows as it speeds up.

runes.name: Fury
runes.about: Frenzied and Lasting, melded. Once it's lit, it doesn't go out.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the frenzy fades one step at a time instead of all at once.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going twice as long.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt, and once fast, it stays fast.

runes.name: Spree
runes.about: Frenzied and Fleeting, melded. All at once, then gone.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, each step twice as big, but the frenzy fades in half the time.
runes.behind: Each kill adds two steps to the frenzy, but it fades in half the time.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt, in sudden bursts.

runes.name: Rampage
runes.about: Frenzied and Vast, melded. The wilder it gets, the more it catches.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, and its area grows with the frenzy, up to much bigger at five.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each hit's splash grows with the frenzy.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt; its attacks reach wider as it gets faster.

runes.name: Sanctuary
runes.about: Guarding and Lasting, melded. A safe place that holds.
runes.front: Each use gives you a shield that lasts twice as long.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle that lasts until the fight is over.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; broken, it grows back after a few seconds.

runes.name: Parry
runes.about: Guarding and Fleeting, melded. A guard held for only an instant, but nothing gets through.
runes.front: Each use gives you a shield for only a moment, but while it is up you take no damage at all.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle that fades fast, but inside it you take no damage.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage; for a moment after each of its attacks, it takes much less damage.

runes.name: Aegis
runes.about: Guarding and Vast, melded. One shield over everyone.
runes.front: Each use gives a brief shield to you and to every ally near you.
runes.behind: Leaves a much bigger ward circle.
runes.monster: Carries a shield that soaks damage, and its shield covers the monsters near it too.

runes.name: Hourglass
runes.about: Lasting and Fleeting, melded. Time on your side, and against them.
runes.front: Everything it puts on enemies lasts half again as long, and every poison, burn or chill on you wears off a third sooner.
runes.behind: What it leaves on the ground lasts half again as long and works a third faster.
runes.monster: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you and hurt you faster too.

runes.name: Aftermath
runes.about: Lasting and Vast, melded. The ground keeps hurting after the blow.
runes.front: A much bigger area, a little less damage; for a few seconds after, enemies that walk into where it struck are hit again, weaker.
runes.behind: Each hit's splash lingers on the ground for a moment, hitting enemies that step into it.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach wider, and the ground where they land keeps hurting you for a few seconds.

runes.name: Whipcrack
runes.about: Fleeting and Vast, melded. Wide, and with no warning.
runes.front: A much bigger area, and the whole of it lands at once with no wind-up.
runes.behind: Each hit's splash goes off at once and reaches farther.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach wider and come with less warning.

runes.name: Maw
runes.about: Pulling and Power, melded. Drag them in, then crush them together.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit that drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; those that meet there crash together and hurt each other.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex that keeps drawing enemies in; when it ends it collapses in a blast, harder for each enemy inside.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its blows drag you toward it, and its next blow after a drag hits harder.

runes.name: Sump
runes.about: Pulling and Poison, melded. Everything drains to one place.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons and drags what it hits toward where it struck; each enemy pulled in takes one more dose for each poisoned enemy beside it, up to three.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex of poison that draws enemies in and poisons them while it holds them.
runes.monster: Poisons you; its blows drag you toward it, and each drag leaves one more dose on you.

runes.name: Drift
runes.about: Pulling and Frost, melded. They slide in on the ice.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; drags what it hits toward where it struck, chilled enemies twice as far, and those that slide into each other freeze (never a boss).
runes.behind: Leaves an icy vortex; enemies drawn across it are slowed, and those that reach its middle freeze for a moment (never a boss).
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows drag you toward it, twice as far while you are chilled.

runes.name: Firewhirl
runes.about: Pulling and Flame, melded. A whirl of fire that feeds on what it gathers.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; the blast drags enemies at its edge into its middle, and those it pulls in burn hotter.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex of fire that draws enemies in and sets burning whatever it holds.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows drag you toward it, and each drag sets you burning again.

runes.name: Lodestone
runes.about: Pulling and Lightning, melded. The bolt drags what it touches along.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes is dragged toward the one it leapt from.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm that draws enemies in; its bolts strike first the ones it has pulled closest.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows drag you toward it, farther while you are shocked.

runes.name: Riptide
runes.about: Pulling and Swift, melded. A current too quick to stand against.
runes.front: Faster to use again; drags what it hits toward where it struck, and each use within a second of the last pulls from farther, up to three times.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies near you are drawn along in your wake.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its blows drag you toward it, and it rushes in after each drag.

runes.name: Gravity
runes.about: Pulling and Heavy, melded. The ground itself pulls everything in.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; drags in everything near where it struck, not only what it hits, and stuns those it pulls in for longer.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex over cracked ground; what it draws in is staggered again and again.
runes.monster: Its blows pull you in instead of knocking you back, and its next blow lands harder.

runes.name: Splinter
runes.about: Splitting and Power, melded. It breaks, and every piece still hits like the whole.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit; breaks into three copies that fly on, each half as strong again as Splitting's, and each knocks back what it hits.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction; each shard that lands builds Power's damage bonus.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; splits in two when it dies, and its halves keep its strength.

runes.name: Spore
runes.about: Splitting and Poison, melded. A sickness that scatters.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons; breaks into three copies that fly on and poison what they hit.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small cloud of poison where it lands.
runes.monster: Poisons you; splits in two when it dies, and each half leaves a puff of poison.

runes.name: Sleet
runes.about: Splitting and Frost, melded. Cold that comes down in pieces.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; breaks into three icy copies that fly on, and a copy that hits a frozen enemy splits again, once.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards of ice fly out and each leaves a patch of ice that slows.
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; splits in two when it dies, and its halves leave ice where they walk.

runes.name: Embers
runes.about: Splitting and Flame, melded. The fire breaks into sparks that start fires of their own.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; breaks into three copies that fly on, each exploding where it lands.
runes.behind: Where it ends, burning shards fly out and each leaves a small patch of burning ground.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; splits in two when it dies, both halves burning.

runes.name: Fractal
runes.about: Splitting and Lightning, melded. Every branch grows branches.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; breaks into three copies that fly on, and each copy arcs on its own.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out, and each one that strikes calls a small bolt down where it lands.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; splits in two when it dies, and a crackling arc joins its halves that hurts you to cross.

runes.name: Scatter
runes.about: Splitting and Swift, melded. The faster you go, the more pieces.
runes.front: Faster to use again; breaks into three copies, and each use within a second of the last makes one more copy, up to five.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, every hit you land throws off a shard.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; splits in two when it dies, and its halves are faster still.

runes.name: Rubble
runes.about: Splitting and Heavy, melded. It breaks like a boulder breaks.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; breaks into three heavy copies that fly on and stagger what they hit.
runes.behind: Where it ends, chunks fly out and crack the ground where each lands, staggering enemies that cross.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back; splits in two when it dies, and each half lands with a knock.

runes.name: Doom
runes.about: Hexing and Power, melded. A curse that deepens with every blow.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit that curses; each hit on a cursed enemy deepens its curse, up to three times.
runes.behind: Leaves a hex circle where enemies deal less damage; each hit you land on an enemy inside builds Power's damage bonus twice as fast.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its blows curse you, and it hits a cursed you harder still.

runes.name: Plague
runes.about: Hexing and Poison, melded. The curse and the sickness pass on together.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons and curses; a cursed enemy that dies passes its curse and its poison to the nearest enemy.
runes.behind: Leaves a hex circle that poisons; enemies inside deal less damage and are poisoned while they stand in it.
runes.monster: Poisons you and curses you; while you are cursed its poison hurts you faster.

runes.name: Hoarfrost
runes.about: Hexing and Frost, melded. A cold that settles into the bones.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and curses; a frozen enemy takes twice the curse's extra damage.
runes.behind: Leaves a hex circle of ice; enemies inside deal less damage and are slowed.
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows curse you, and the curse lasts twice as long while you are chilled.

runes.name: Brimstone
runes.about: Hexing and Flame, melded. Damning fire.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and curses them; a cursed enemy burns hotter.
runes.behind: Leaves a burning hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage and are set burning.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows curse you, and your burning lasts longer while you are cursed.

runes.name: Jinx
runes.about: Hexing and Lightning, melded. Bad luck that jumps from one to the next.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; each arc carries the curse to the enemy it strikes.
runes.behind: Leaves a storm inside a hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage, and its bolts strike cursed enemies first.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows curse you, and its arcs reach you from farther while you are cursed.

runes.name: Whisper
runes.about: Hexing and Swift, melded. A curse said quickly, again and again.
runes.front: Faster to use again; curses what it hits, and hitting an enemy already cursed takes a little more off its wait.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies you pass close by are cursed.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its blows curse you, and it moves faster still while you are cursed.

runes.name: Burden
runes.about: Hexing and Heavy, melded. A weight laid on the soul.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, and curses; the curse lasts twice as long on a stunned enemy.
runes.behind: Leaves cracked ground inside a hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage, and those it staggers are cursed.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back and curse you; you are knocked farther while you are cursed.

runes.name: Stasis
runes.about: Stilling and Power, melded. The blow is held, then lands again.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit that slows what it hits in time; when the slow ends, a quarter of the damage it took lands again.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble where enemies and their shots crawl; while you stand in it, Power's damage bonus doesn't fade.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its blows slow your cooldowns, and it hits harder the slower they are.

runes.name: Stagnation
runes.about: Stilling and Poison, melded. Still water goes bad.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons and slows what it hits in time; the poison on a slowed enemy doesn't wear off until the slow ends.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble that fills with poison; enemies crawl in it and are poisoned.
runes.monster: Poisons you; its blows slow your cooldowns, and your poison wears off more slowly.

runes.name: Frostlock
runes.about: Stilling and Frost, melded. Locked in ice and in time.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and slows what it hits in time; a slowed enemy freezes sooner and stays frozen longer (never a boss).
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble of cold where enemies and their shots crawl; those that stay in it a while freeze (never a boss).
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows slow your cooldowns too.

runes.name: Slow Burn
runes.about: Stilling and Flame, melded. A fire that takes its time.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and slows them in time; a slowed enemy burns twice as long, as hot.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble over burning ground; enemies crawl through the fire.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows slow your cooldowns, and your burning lasts longer.

runes.name: Stormglass
runes.about: Stilling and Lightning, melded. Lightning caught in the air, waiting.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs and slows what it hits in time; its arcs hang between slowed enemies and strike again when the slow ends.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble with a storm inside; its bolts strike everything the bubble holds.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows slow your cooldowns, and its shock lasts longer on you.

runes.name: Timeslip
runes.about: Stilling and Swift, melded. Their time slows, yours doesn't.
runes.front: Faster to use again; slows what it hits in time, and each slowed enemy near you takes a little more off its wait.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble where enemies crawl and you move faster.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its blows slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Standstill
runes.about: Stilling and Heavy, melded. The stun that time forgot to end.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a stunned enemy is also slowed in time, so its stun lasts half as long again.
runes.behind: Leaves a bubble over cracked ground; enemies crawl through it and are staggered again and again.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back and slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Shackle
runes.about: Binding and Power, melded. Hold it still, then hit it where it stands.
runes.front: More damage and a bigger hit that holds what it hits in place; your hits on a held enemy hit harder.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare that bites as it closes, hurting what it catches as well as holding it.
runes.monster: Hits harder and has more life; its blows root you, and it hits harder while you are rooted.

runes.name: Strangler
runes.about: Binding and Poison, melded. Thorned vines that hold and sting.
runes.front: A weaker hit that poisons and holds what it hits; poison bites twice as fast on a held enemy.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare of poisoned thorns; what it catches is held and poisoned.
runes.monster: Poisons you; its blows root you, and you are poisoned faster while rooted.

runes.name: Icebound
runes.about: Binding and Frost, melded. Held fast by the ice.
runes.front: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and holds what it hits; a held enemy chills twice as fast.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare of ice; what it catches is held, then frozen (never a boss).
runes.monster: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows root you, longer while you are chilled.

runes.name: Firetrap
runes.about: Binding and Flame, melded. The snare that catches fire.
runes.front: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and holds them; a held enemy burns hotter.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare that bursts into flame when it catches an enemy, setting everything near it burning.
runes.monster: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows root you, and you burn hotter while rooted.

runes.name: Tether
runes.about: Binding and Lightning, melded. Bound together by the bolt.
runes.front: Lightning damage that arcs and holds what it hits; while two held enemies are near, arcs leap between them again and again.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare that, when it catches an enemy, sends a bolt to every enemy near it.
runes.monster: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows root you, and it shocks you again while you are rooted.

runes.name: Lasso
runes.about: Binding and Swift, melded. Thrown fast, pulled tight.
runes.front: Faster to use again; holds what it hits, and each use within a second of the last holds a little longer, up to three times.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, the first enemy you pass is caught in a snare.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster; its blows root you.

runes.name: Anchor
runes.about: Binding and Heavy, melded. What it hits isn't going anywhere.
runes.front: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; holds what it hits, and a held enemy is stunned twice as long.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare over cracked ground; what it catches is held and staggered.
runes.monster: Its blows root you where you stand instead of knocking you back, and hit harder while you can't move.

runes.name: Confluence
runes.about: Pulling and Splitting, melded. The pieces fly out and drag it all back to one place.
runes.front: Breaks into three copies that fly on; each drags what it hits back toward where the first one struck.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out, then a vortex draws them back in, hitting again on the way.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it; splits in two when it dies, and both halves drag you.

runes.name: Beckon
runes.about: Pulling and Hexing, melded. The curse calls them closer.
runes.front: Curses what it hits and drags it toward where it struck; a cursed enemy is dragged twice as far.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex inside a hex circle; what it draws in deals less damage.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it and curse you.

runes.name: Horizon
runes.about: Pulling and Stilling, melded. The closer they come, the slower they move.
runes.front: Drags what it hits toward where it struck and slows it in time when it gets there.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex that slows in time whatever it draws in.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it and slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Reel
runes.about: Pulling and Binding, melded. Hooked, hauled in, held.
runes.front: Drags what it hits toward where it struck and holds it there.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare with a vortex round it that draws enemies onto the snare.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it and root you there.

runes.name: Coven
runes.about: Splitting and Hexing, melded. Many voices saying one curse.
runes.front: Breaks into three copies that fly on and curse what they hit; an enemy cursed by two copies is cursed for twice as long.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small hex circle where it lands.
runes.monster: Curses you; splits in two when it dies, both halves cursing.

runes.name: Constellation
runes.about: Splitting and Stilling, melded. The pieces hang in the air, then fall.
runes.front: Breaks into three copies that hang still in the air for a moment, then fly at the nearest enemies and slow in time what they hit.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out and stop in the air; whatever touches one is slowed in time.
runes.monster: Its blows slow your cooldowns; splits in two when it dies.

runes.name: Web
runes.about: Splitting and Binding, melded. Strands in every direction.
runes.front: Breaks into three copies that fly on and hold what they hit; an enemy held by two copies is held twice as long.
runes.behind: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small snare where it lands.
runes.monster: Its blows root you; splits in two when it dies, both halves rooting.

runes.name: Torpor
runes.about: Hexing and Stilling, melded. A heavy, cursed sleep.
runes.front: Curses what it hits and slows it in time; a cursed and slowed enemy takes more damage still.
runes.behind: Leaves a circle that hexes and stills; enemies inside crawl and deal less damage.
runes.monster: Its blows curse you and slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Witchknot
runes.about: Hexing and Binding, melded. A knot tied with a curse.
runes.front: Curses and holds what it hits; a held and cursed enemy takes more damage still.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare inside a hex circle; what it catches is held and cursed.
runes.monster: Its blows curse you and root you.

runes.name: Amber
runes.about: Stilling and Binding, melded. Caught fast, and time stops around it.
runes.front: Holds what it hits and slows it in time, and the hold lasts as long as the slow.
runes.behind: Leaves a snare inside a bubble; what it catches is held and slowed in time.
runes.monster: Its blows root you and slow your cooldowns.

runes.name: Twin II
runes.about: Two Twin, melded: Twin at level 2.
runes.front: Strikes, fires or bursts three times, each a little weaker.
runes.behind: Repeats itself twice, each repeat weaker.
runes.monster: Attacks three times.

runes.name: Leech II
runes.about: Two Leech, melded: Leech at level 2.
runes.front: Heals you for every enemy hit, half as much again.
runes.behind: Enemies it kills drop life orbs more often.
runes.monster: Heals when it hits you, half as much again.

runes.name: Volatile II
runes.about: Two Volatile, melded: Volatile at level 2.
runes.front: Enemies it kills explode, half as big and hard again.
runes.behind: Leaves a rune that detonates half as big and hard again.
runes.monster: Explodes when it dies, half as hard again.

runes.name: Precise II
runes.about: Two Precise, melded: Precise at level 2.
runes.front: More damage still, a smaller area still.
runes.behind: Marks an enemy: your next two hits on it are certain criticals.
runes.monster: Its hits find the gaps in your armour, half as much again.

runes.name: Frenzied II
runes.about: Two Frenzied, melded: Frenzied at level 2.
runes.front: Each use makes the next faster, each step half as big again, up to five times.
runes.behind: Kills keep the frenzy going, half as long again.
runes.monster: Speeds up as it is hurt, half as much again.

runes.name: Guarding II
runes.about: Two Guarding, melded: Guarding at level 2.
runes.front: Each use gives you a brief shield, half as big again.
runes.behind: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you take even less damage.
runes.monster: Carries a shield half as big again.

runes.name: Lasting II
runes.about: Two Lasting, melded: Lasting at level 2.
runes.front: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
runes.behind: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
runes.monster: Its poison, burning and chill last longer still on you.

runes.name: Fleeting II
runes.about: Two Fleeting, melded: Fleeting at level 2.
runes.front: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
runes.behind: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
runes.monster: Its poison and burning hurt you faster still.

runes.name: Vast II
runes.about: Two Vast, melded: Vast at level 2.
runes.front: An even bigger area, a little less damage.
runes.behind: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.
runes.monster: Its attacks reach even wider.

runes.name: Swift II
runes.about: Two Swift, melded: Swift at level 2.
runes.front: Faster to use again, half as much again.
runes.behind: Each use gives you a burst of speed, half as big again.
runes.monster: Moves and attacks faster, half as much again.

runes.name: Heavy II
runes.about: Two Heavy, melded: Heavy at level 2.
runes.front: Slower, hits harder still, and stuns half as long again.
runes.behind: Leaves wider cracked ground that staggers longer.
runes.monster: Its blows knock you back farther.

runes.name: Pulling II
runes.about: Two Pulling, melded: Pulling at level 2.
runes.front: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck, from half as far again.
runes.behind: Leaves a vortex half as wide and strong again.
runes.monster: Its blows drag you toward it, half as far again.

runes.name: Splitting II
runes.about: Two Splitting, melded: Splitting at level 2.
runes.front: Breaks into four copies instead of three, each a little stronger.
runes.behind: Half as many shards again, flying farther.
runes.monster: Splits in three when it dies.

runes.name: Hexing II
runes.about: Two Hexing, melded: Hexing at level 2.
runes.front: Its curse is half as strong again.
runes.behind: Its hex circle is half as wide and strong again.
runes.monster: Its curse on you is half as strong again.

runes.name: Stilling II
runes.about: Two Stilling, melded: Stilling at level 2.
runes.front: What it hits is slowed in time half as much again.
runes.behind: Its bubble is half as wide again and lasts half as long again.
runes.monster: Its blows slow your cooldowns half as much again.

runes.name: Binding II
runes.about: Two Binding, melded: Binding at level 2.
runes.front: Holds the enemies it hits half as long again.
runes.behind: Its snare catches the next two enemies to cross it.
runes.monster: Its blows root you half as long again.
